items.title: Baththa: Balaji Tharaneetharan’s Vijay Sethupathi-starrer is powered by a big heart
items.summary: At its core, Balaji Tharaneetharan’s Baththa is a story of love and redemption. Of how, two contrasting people separated by age, power and position can be put together in a situation and yet return with one’s innocence intact and another’s conscience restored. It helps that Baththa , set in the 1980s, is headlined by an in-form Vijay Sethupathi (Baththa) and Master Sai Prithviraj (Sabari), and written and directed superbly by Balaji Tharaneetharan of Naduvula Konjam Pakkatha Kaanom and Seethakathi fame. What happens when gangster Baththa is locked inside a bathroom by terrified little Sabari? This is the basic premise that Balaji builds on. As is expected from Balaji, what you see is not what you get. He shows you something, but what he intends you to see is the gift you receive when you stay invested enough. Like, for example, the title card. Pay close attention to it, for it resides in your mind and adds to the laughter written into a later scene. In Balaji’s world, the things that cause trouble are interesting, and unlikely — if it was a cricket ball in Naduvula, it is Sabari, the terrified child, here. items.title: 30-year-old NOIDA housing dispute: Supreme Court appoints former judge to identify genuine allottees
items.summary: The Supreme Court recently constituted a one-member high-powered independent committee headed by former Allahabad High Court Justice Sudhir Kumar Saxena to finalise the list of genuine members and subsequent purchasers entitled to multi-storeyed flats in NOIDA [ New Okhla Industrial Development Authority v. Kendriya Karamchari Sehkari GN Samiti & Ors. ] A Bench comprising Chief Justice of India Surya Kant , Justice Joymalya Bagchi , and Justice V Mohana constituted the committee on September 24 after observing that the verification process remained deadlocked despite repeated affidavits and directions. "Having regard to the fact that this process has remained inconclusive despite repeated affidavits and directions and considering that a large number of the original allottee-members have been awaiting the fruits of litigation for over three decades, we are satisfied that an independent verification mechanism to decide the competing claims and implement this Court’s earlier directions is necessary, " the Court ordered. CJI Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi, Justice V Mohana The dispute stemmed from a long sequence of litigation concerning the Kendriya Karamchari Sehkari GN Samiti.
